$comment: Progressive checkJs. checkJs is OFF: only files carrying a top-level '// @ts-check' pragma are type-checked, so adding one is a per-file opt-in. Start with strict:false; raise per-module as the backlog clears. noEmit:true means this never produces build artifacts — the shipped .js files stay exactly as they are (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: source is the publishable).
